title: duel
summary: MSUI implements the byte-pinned build-5875 duel family: strict arbiter+challenger request, empty bounds packets, u8 complete flag, u8 plus two terminated names winner packet, millisecond countdown truncation, all eight opcodes, inbound dispatch, and both full-arbiter-GUID reply bodies.

openItems.text: SMSG_DUEL_REQUESTED / SMSG_DUEL_COUNTDOWN / SMSG_DUEL_INBOUNDS / SMSG_DUEL_OUTOFBOUNDS / SMSG_DUEL_COMPLETE / SMSG_DUEL_WINNER: no handlers
openItems.resolution: DuelPackets strictly parses all six inbound shapes and GameLoop.Net dispatches each opcode into the duel state/chat/popup adapter.
WorldSession and NetworkClient expose both reply sends using DuelPackets.BuildReplyBody, an exact little-endian full arbiter GUID.
